candidates.change_summary: Return bytes32(0) instead of the ERC-1967 implementation slot.
Return the ERC-1967 admin slot instead of the implementation slot.
Return the ERC-1967 beacon slot instead of the implementation slot.
Remove the __Access_init(_accessControl) call so the access control address is never set, leaving it address(0) and making subsequent access-checked calls revert.
Pass address(1) instead of _accessControl to __Access_init so access checks always query the wrong (non-access-control) contract and fail.
Remove the initializer modifier so initialize can be called repeatedly (re-initialization is possible), changing behavior of subsequent initialize calls.
Remove the 'emit Initialized(1);' statement so the Initialized event is no longer emitted on top-level initialization, an observable difference at the initialize surface.
Remove the '$._initializing = false;' reset after the initializer body so _initializing stays true, causing any subsequent initialize call to revert with InvalidInitialization.
Replace '$._initialized = 1;' with '$._initialized = 2;' so the stored initialized version differs, making a later initialize (or reinitializer with version 2) behave differently.
Change the guard condition to 'if (!initialSetup)' so the 'construction' path is no longer allowed, causing initialization during construction-time state (initialized == 1 with empty code) to revert.
